| `--claim <feature>` | Declare a feature the server offers, so the report shows it as claimed. One of
`lazy-authentication` or `enterprise-managed-auth`. Repeat to claim several (at most 10). An unknown value is a usage error. |\n|
`--lazy-auth-probe` | Opt in to the lazy-authentication probe. The probe calls one public tool, then one protected tool, both **wi
thout credentials**. It makes at most two calls and calls only tools annotated `readOnlyHint: true`. Without the two flags below,
it picks the tools from their `securitySchemes`. |\n| `--lazy-auth-tool <name>` | The protected tool the probe calls. Implies `--l
azy-auth-probe`. Up to 128 characters. |\n| `--lazy-auth-public-tool <name>` | The public tool the probe calls first. Implies `--l

azy-auth-probe`. Up to 128 characters, and it must name a different tool than `--lazy-auth-tool`. |
